decision_question: How can all 34 source folios become a 30-minute film without changing source results, geography, character identity or release gates?
synthesis: One 30-minute Commonwealth film preserves the source's six causal matchups, score provenance, varied world weather, emotional choices and physical blocking. Emphasize geography-first staging, long-form continuity, separate sound stems and editorial rhythm; no automatic canon promotion.

accepted.observation: The field throne is an established place and its chair/battery/steps control blocking.
accepted.proposal: Build one shared dimensional set plate across P22-P24, with reusable stair and battery anchors; reject unrelated throne-room changes.
accepted.rationale: A reusable set layout prevents jump cuts from altering what surrender means.

accepted.observation: One storm presents regional differences; coast, bridge and wetland are not adjacent.
accepted.proposal: Maintain three distinct weather looks with explicit editorial time transition; use bridge master for orientation.
accepted.rationale: Visual cohesion without fictional instant travel.

accepted.observation: Three Dreaded Snake has exactly three heads on one body; other characters retain their species locks.
accepted.proposal: Preapprove silhouette, rig topology and motion tests for nonhuman characters before all ensemble frames.

accepted.observation: Red carries wet mud from field into later Forgotten Court, across separated locations.
accepted.proposal: Keep tracked costume wetness, surface mud and material wear per character/time; recheck after edits.
accepted.rationale: Weather and travel effects must persist without cloning character assets.

accepted.observation: Humiliation is public and reactive; the captured outlaw is not an injured generic victim.
accepted.proposal: Hold gaze toward galleries after the secure manual binding, with physically readable body language.
accepted.rationale: Performance delivers emotional stakes without inventing an injury or dialogue.

accepted.observation: A hound on soft shoulder, truck on raised strip, driver in cab establish opposed scales.
accepted.proposal: Design legible silhouettes from both POVs; maintain truck/tire/animal separation throughout.
accepted.rationale: Readable silhouette communicates a blockade that is never an actual collision.

accepted.observation: Birthday reveal relies on distinct guest, host and wrapped prop in a coherent room.
accepted.proposal: Lock lens/eyelines and one spatial master before coverage; preserve subject scale and birthday light.
accepted.rationale: Shot continuity beats disconnected posed hero portraits.

accepted.observation: The Storm Coast terrace and Central Basin court occupy different exposures.
accepted.proposal: Create separate scoped color palettes anchored to regional conditions; keep readable faces.
accepted.rationale: One blanket storm LUT falsely merges geography.

accepted.observation: Pause, hope, deliberate volume increase and resumed drilling form an ordered comic choice.
accepted.proposal: Reserve real silent screen time before the purposeful escalation, with reaction footage serving causality.
accepted.rationale: A nonstop jackhammer montage would erase the joke.

accepted.observation: The Commonwealth changes unevenly under one regional front.
accepted.proposal: Use ordinary infrastructure wear and continued roads to sell world history without a map-dump.
accepted.rationale: Inhabited world depth should be legible from material consequences.

accepted.observation: Refused protection for surrender creates a meaningful choice.
accepted.proposal: Allow silence and facial/body hesitation at the refusal, not merely a spectacle countdown.
accepted.rationale: Moral imagination is expressed through actual costs and temptation.

accepted.observation: The league has six matchups and twelve distinct lives; results cannot erase the losers.
accepted.proposal: Cross-check each story's two subjects and distinct aftermath against the official board.
accepted.rationale: Ensemble integrity and causal pressure prevent winner-only mythologizing.

accepted.observation: Opening a burger gift is separate from the later cake impact.
accepted.proposal: Protect three distinct beats: invitation, box reveal and delayed cake consequence.
accepted.rationale: Setup and payoff work only if reveal and physical joke are temporally distinct.

accepted.observation: Public sports-data folios must remain readable without stalling the movie.
accepted.proposal: Use economical graphic inserts and a clear spoken transition into the next dramatic scene.
accepted.rationale: Information should propel the story instead of becoming a spreadsheet slideshow.

accepted.observation: The civic address is an inhabited institution, not a commissioner portrait reveal.
accepted.proposal: Show restrained ordinary work and read exact supplied copy; preserve a separate institutional voice.
accepted.rationale: Voice/culture emerge from labor and lived place.

accepted.observation: Lightning is a surviving battery consequence, not unmotivated magic.
accepted.proposal: Diagram the first disabled battery, remaining charge path, controlling gesture and field effects before VFX.
accepted.rationale: Hard spatial mechanics create causality and readable costs.

accepted.observation: The bent rim and mud carry an intimate loss beyond team statistics.
accepted.proposal: Stay in the ruined court long enough to register fingers on the loose net and accumulated exhaustion.

dissent.observation: The lasso closes around torso/upper arms, never neck; skid causes fall before manual tie.
dissent.proposal: Use three causal movement setups and stunt-safe geometry references before any AI motion render.
dissent.rationale: The source explicitly prevents instant knots and hazardous neck catches.

dissent.observation: Lightning moves from the surviving battery after the chair-side refusal and hand signal.
dissent.proposal: Maintain shot-linked VFX source versions, seeds, output hashes, masks, negative constraints and editable sound stems.
dissent.rationale: A fully baked one-pass clip is not compositable source authority.

dissent.observation: The household waterfall, courtyard machinery and speaker form layered acoustic sources.
dissent.proposal: Produce separate compressor, jackhammer, waterfall and music stems; withhold identifiable licensed song cues.
dissent.rationale: Sound is a story mechanism requiring editability and clearance.

execution_note: Validation/reconciliation executed against repository code. Creative findings are modeled using documented published-method domains, NOT independently performed human consultant reviews, board votes or real agent consultations.
